Telangana CM Reddy Seeks Centre's Action on Hyderabad Metro Takeover

Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy has urged the central government to expedite the appointment of SBI CAPS. This appointment is crucial for the potential takeover of the Hyderabad Metro Rail. Reddy also reviewed tourism development plans in Hyderabad.
